subject: post
title: (R)POST.------MTH.
description: Diagram in T(AF)M-19. (R)POST — the reality of postulation — is crossed with MTH (methodology). Embedded in the part of the section where Braxton discusses source-transfer implications and how western misdocumentation has reduced trans-African creativity to fragments of itself. The diagram poses: when postulation's *reality* (not its concept) is crossed with methodology, what is the structural chain? POST is fed by C-AF-ALGN (composite affinity alignment) → PART (participation), with C-AF-ALGN also feeding DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) — so participation is itself produced by the affinity-alignment-dynamic-functionalism dyad. POST → MTH → CRTF-D (cross-transfer definitions) → INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis): the methodological chain ends in information affinity basis only via cross-transfer definitions, which Braxton names elsewhere as the western redocumentation device. POST also branches to WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle) and T-C-IMP (time continuum implications), and T-C-IMP solid-links to ALT-F (alternative functionalism) and AF-NT (affinity nature). The structural claim: real postulation only reaches methodology through participation grounded in composite-affinity-alignment, and methodology's terminal node is information-affinity-basis — but only via cross-transfer definitions, the very mechanism that has historically distorted black creativity.
